scope: EF local WSL only under intraday-chart-sequence-v1, original S1 and S2 dated universe, spent discovery dates only

entry_clock.exit_clock_rule: modeled exit OPEN strictly before registered session close minus buffer

labels.target_scale: 100 times exact Fraction return, in percentage points
labels.point_return: exit OPEN / entry OPEN - 1, with both exact endpoints mature
labels.path: full held minute HIGH/LOW through the minute preceding exit, plus the exit OPEN; no exit-minute HIGH/LOW
labels.missing: endpoint labels stay distinct from unknown interior; each auxiliary head retains its own availability mask; no missing outcome is a zero return
labels.availability: source minutes use completed minute plus two as an explicitly assumed observation clock; training uses only labels with all contributing observations strictly before first evaluation opening

population_and_folds.common_support: original target plus chart latest60 complete and at least5 original peers complete before decision, with deterministic clock fit; never selected using any future labels
population_and_folds.training: same ordered common-support coordinates with mature known 30-minute point label for all five learned arms; unknown auxiliary outcomes masked only in auxiliary losses
population_and_folds.unsupported: retain original evaluation coordinates and unavailable predictions; no substitute learner or zero-return assignment
population_and_folds.wide_chart_diagnostic: apply the same chart-only fit to chart-supported evaluation rows outside the common peer scope, report separately and disclose distribution shift

learners.evaluation: paired chart-versus-peer within learner family, ordered versus permuted chart TCN under same architecture and loss, TCN versus simple and LightGBM controls; no post-result winner promotion

tcn.chart_slots: ten minute channels, six coarse and five static from intraday_chart_tensors; three peer sequence channels and one coverage scalar reserved in both modes and zero constants in chart-only mode
tcn.architecture: pointwise input projection plus ReLU, width-preserving causal left-padded kernel3 convolution and ReLU residual per dilation; take the last hidden token from each tower, concatenate static, then linear to six outputs
tcn.loss: primary masked MSE weight1 plus each auxiliary masked MSE weight0.2, each averaged over its available rows in the batch; empty auxiliary head contributes no gradient
tcn.epoch_order: fixed CPU torch Generator seeded once per fit with seed+fold_index, randperm train rows each epoch, all rows including final short batch
tcn.order_ablation: retrain same chart-only architecture and loss on the registered per-coordinate minute/coarse prefix permutation; last tokens and masked coarse slots fixed; tests sensitivity to supplied order, not complete removal of all recoverable timing clues
tcn.native: retained pinned CPU PyTorch runtime, finite float32 tensors and parameters, deterministic one native thread, no tuning or evaluation-informed early stop

lightgbm.configuration: existing intraday_campaign_ml_models fixed native LightGBM parameters, float64 feature inputs and native labels, same gross30 prediction units
lightgbm.features: intraday_chart_tensors.TABULAR_CHART_NAMES (38), followed by TABULAR_PEER_NAMES (4) only in the peer arm. Both use the same numerical source tensors as TCN. The chart summaries use last5/15/30/60 minutes. The optional mean observed volume has its accompanying coverage. The peer summaries retain 60-minute mean minute OC, last cumulative return/positive breadth and coverage.
lightgbm.reuse: existing fit, native serialization, reload and independent scalar prediction replay

management.entry_admission: strict gross30 prediction above 0.33 percentage points at entry grid; no new entry when model or required chart support unavailable
management.cost_sensitivity: same prediction admission and paired quantities; charge each assumption once against original entry notional
management.fixed: close at entry plus30 minutes using registered retrospective OPEN
management.dynamic: use the same fold fit and causal input transformation at 5,10,15 minutes after entry, score gross15 at the update decision one minute before each modeled OPEN; keep if positive, reduce floor half once on first nonpositive, liquidate remaining on two consecutive available nonpositive updates, or at the original fixed clock; missing forecast breaks the consecutive streak without generating a sale
management.isolation: same baseline entry identities, price, nominal quantity and initial basis; paired path ledger does not redeploy freed cash or claim a continuous account; separate aggregate account assessment retains existing capital/risk gates and explicit unknowns
management.frozen_boundaries: no add-ons or forced weekly quota; unverified execution stops affected cash mutations, valuation-only gap preserves known exits

report: original population, same decision support and path/endpoint missingness by scenario and fold
paired forecast error and rank diagnostic
observed gross and 33/43 bp net, opportunity count per observed week including zero weeks, and uncertainty by trading-session clusters
paired fixed versus dynamic performance and exposure, partial/full reasons and unclear fills
nominal valuation limits and no claim about actual execution or promoted strategy
